adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Rhizomelic disproportionate short stature with the common FGFR3 Gly380Arg variant identifies achondroplasia from constitutive inhibitory FGFR3 signaling in growth-plate chondrocytes.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: FGFR3 loss would increase rather than suppress growth, while COL2A1, FBN1, and SHOX disorders have different molecular and phenotypic patterns. The explicit FGFR3 Gly380Arg variant makes gain-of-function inhibition uniquely correct.
